cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

mechanism: A manages disclosure of a fireworks invoice by conceding B a smaller question while first pinning down the authorization boundary.
confusable: Unlike general blame shifting, A seeks B precise permission and timing before revealing the purchase.
comparison: A rocket invoice and trailer limit differ from invitations and message timestamps.
seedUse: D184-a sparklers and trailer; S02-a narrows the requested answer to keep B in A ordered disclosure.
